title: Endo-Parameters For Classical Groups
body_html:
Endo-Parameters For Classical Groups

Let $V$ be an $\varepsilon$-Hermitian space over $F/F_0$, and let $G=U(V)$.

The draft defines a map

$$ \ell^*:\mathscr{EP}_{\varepsilon}(F)^\sigma \to \operatorname{herm}_{\varepsilon}(F/F_0). $$

For a self-dual extension $(E,\beta)$, the map

$$ \ell_\beta:E\to F $$

is the unique $F$-linear map satisfying

$$ \ell_\beta(\beta^i) = \begin{cases} 1,&i=0,\\ 0,&1\leq i<[E:F]. \end{cases} $$

It induces

$$ \ell_\beta^*: \operatorname{herm}_{\varepsilon}(E/E_0) \to \operatorname{herm}_{\varepsilon}(F/F_0) $$

by composing Hermitian forms with $\ell_\beta$.

For a non-self-dual endo-class, the draft sends a vector-space class $V$ to

$$ V^*\oplus V $$

with $V$ and $V^*$ totally isotropic and the natural pairing between them.

Putting the self-dual and non-self-dual contributions together gives $\ell^*$.

The endo-parameters for $V$ are

$$ \mathscr{EP}(V):=(\ell^*)^{-1}([V]). $$

The positive part $\mathscr{EP}^+(V)$ is obtained by restricting parameters to $\mathscr E^+(F)$. The draft states that the restriction

$$ \mathscr{EP}(V)\to\mathscr{EP}^+(V) $$

is a bijection.

Draft Caution

The current TeX cites compatibility of $\ell_\beta^*$ with the transfer maps $\mathfrak w_{\varepsilon,\beta',\beta}$ rather than proving it. The precise definition should eventually be extracted from the registered KSS PDF source.
